C-FIX-016-AUTOSAVE-DISABLE-RACE.Name: Honor Auto Save when disabled during debounce
C-FIX-016-AUTOSAVE-DISABLE-RACE.Summary: Prevent a queued Auto Save timer from writing after the user turns Auto Save off. The timer callback must re-read the current preference immediately before invoking the save transport.
C-FIX-016-AUTOSAVE-DISABLE-RACE.Problem: Risk-30 records that HANDLE_AUTO_SAVE captures only the delay. A timer already queued while Auto Save is enabled still saves after the preference becomes false.
C-FIX-016-AUTOSAVE-DISABLE-RACE.ApprovalBasis: The owner instructed the standard GRACE plan, verification and two-clean-review workflow for the agreed post-2.6 stabilization boundary on 2026-10-20.

Goals.Goal: Make disabling Auto Save an immediate barrier for queued debounce callbacks.
Preserve normal debounce, already-saved checks, errors and later re-enabled saves.

Constraints.Constraint: Re-read the Pinia preference at callback time; do not add a second timer registry or cancel unrelated document timers globally.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No preference UI redesign, session autosave change, manual-save change, release or platform work.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A dirty named tab queued while Auto Save is true is not written if the preference is false when the timer fires.
Re-enabling Auto Save allows the next content change to queue and save normally; existing debounce and saved-tab guards stay green.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Fake-timer tests assert disabled-at-fire skip, normal save after re-enable and no transport invocation for the cancelled write.

Assumptions.Assumption: The preference store is available in the timer callback because HANDLE_AUTO_SAVE already depends on it at scheduling time.
